sources.title: Ulrich Schollwöck, The density-matrix renormalization group in the age of matrix product states, Annals of Physics 326 (2011), complete 122-page review
sources.locator: Complete 122-page review inspected; §§4.4.1–4.4.2, canonical MPS forms; §§6.2–6.4, DMRG effective Hamiltonians, local updates, and two-site truncation.

contents.name: §§4.4.1–4.4.2, left/right canonical MPS forms and orthonormal environments
contents.reason: The local exact QR proof gives a deterministic rank-revealing factorization and proves each absorption preserves the represented tensor.

contents.name: §§6.2–6.3, local DMRG eigenproblem and effective Hamiltonian
contents.reason: The local interface computation proves E*E=I and H_eff=E*HE is Hermitian from the explicit canonical isometry assumptions.

contents.name: §6.3, local ground-state update decreases the variational energy before truncation
contents.reason: The local proof pulls the finite ground Rayleigh minimum back through the isometric center embedding.

contents.name: §§6.3–6.4, finite one-site/two-site sweep and SVD center shifts
contents.reason: The item specifies finite exact arithmetic, both pass directions, full local solves, exact SVD splits, and the optional post-sweep rank-cap branch.

contents.name: §6.4, two-site truncation after a variational update
contents.reason: The local theorem combines the exact local energy decrease, the TT root-sum-square error, normalization, and an explicit Rayleigh perturbation estimate.

sources.title: Grégoire Misguich, Introduction to matrix-product states and tensor networks, complete lecture notes (2026), 64 pages
sources.locator: Complete 64-page lecture notes inspected; §2.1 periodic MPS; §§2.4.1–2.4.3 canonical forms; §2.7 DMRG/effective Hamiltonian and two-site update (PDF pp. 24–26).

contents.name: §2.1, periodic boundary-condition MPS and trace contraction
contents.reason: The local proof expands the trace and gives an entrywise exact pair-index conversion to open-boundary TT form.

contents.name: §§2.4.1–2.4.3, canonical forms, gauge moves, and center tensors
contents.reason: The local definition fixes its own open-boundary and periodic index conventions, normalized-state domain, and finite Hermitian input.

contents.name: §§2.4.1–2.4.3, canonical form interfaces and norm preservation
contents.reason: The proof contracts the prefix/suffix interfaces and derives the center isometry from the stated left/right core identities.

contents.name: §2.7, DMRG effective Hamiltonian and exact local update
contents.reason: The local proposition states the exact Hermitian ground solve and proves the energy comparison before truncation.

contents.name: §2.7, two-site update, SVD split, and post-update truncation
contents.reason: The local algorithm makes the finite sweep order and exact SVD orientation explicit and separates exact splits from optional rank truncation.

contents.name: §2.7, limitations of a local variational solve and post-sweep truncation
contents.reason: The local estimate records the conditional norm and tail hypotheses needed to control energy after normalization.

contents.name: §2, Theorem 2.2 and proof, root-sum-square TT-SVD discarded-tail estimate
contents.reason: The sweep theorem invokes the batch-10 TT error statement for the actual recorded tails and proves the remaining normalization and energy steps locally.

contents.name: §3, right-to-left TT rounding, core SVDs, and discarded tails
contents.reason: The DMRG algorithm calls the exact rank-cap rounding supplier only after a complete sweep and records its tail outputs.

contents.name: §3, exact orthogonalization before TT compression
contents.reason: The local proof supplies its own deterministic exact QR gauge construction rather than relying on a numerical rank threshold.
